tools.name: find_logos
tools.description: Look up logos for domains or product names. Returns, per query: found/fallback, confidence (0 = placeholder), name, source URL and size, and public PNG/WebP/ICO/SVG URLs.

tools.name: get_logo_image
tools.description: Return one logo as an image you can look at, plus its URL. Use to check a logo before placing it. Options: size (16-256), bg (hex, white, black), pad (0-40 percent), trim.

tools.name: company_stack
tools.description: Find which tools a company uses (client portals, practice software, email, CRM, analytics), from its website and DNS. Every tool comes with the evidence that was observed and a confidence. Absence of a tool means no evidence was found, not that the company does not use it.

tools.name: logo_set
tools.description: Return logos as a matched set for one background and size: same visual weight and padding, full color or one tone, with warnings when a logo will not read on the background. Missing logos become neutral stand-in tiles marked standIn: true. Includes a row_url that renders the whole set as one PNG str

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_logo_image · Public sink: company_stack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_logo_image · Public sink: company_stack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
